description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

The aethyric winds seem drawn to you and you move as if underwater, your clothes and hair buffeted by strange currents - drifting upwards and moving against the natural winds. It all looks quite disturbing. You can, with a successful Challenging (+0) Willpower Test, levitate your own body. You gain the Flight Creature Trait with a rating equal to your level in Levitation x30 for Willpower Bonus + SL Rounds. You suffer a Minor Miscast if you Fumble your Willpower Test. Each additional time you gain this mutation the duration doubles.
